svg.title: TokyoAdwaita Night — Fedora GNOME desktop preview
svg.desc: Editable vector desktop mockup based on a supplied Fedora desktop screenshot. TokyoNight peach highlights, purple Papirus folders, dark app windows, GNOME Shell quick settings, and a custom dock. Stylized reconstruction, not a native screen capture.

g.text: Disables Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and mobile broadband
